# org: review labels by settings

Manage the repository's issue labels as code. **Motivation:** "automate their management" — the [Probot Settings app](https://github.com/apps/settings) applies a `.github/settings.yml` to the repository (features, merge options, branch protection, labels), so the label scheme used to classify issues ([[DOT-301]]) can be versioned and shared with the author's other repositories.
